component.name: ChatonLM
component.summary: Unofficial desktop chat client for Ollama

description.p: ChatonLM is an independent, open-source desktop app for chatting with large language models that Ollama runs on this computer or on another one. It includes its own copy of Ollama, using the processor or the graphics card (Vulkan), for computers without it. Its design follows the official Ollama app for Windows and macOS.

ul.li: Chats with history, favorites, attachments, thinking and web search
Model management: download, load and browse models
Local dictation and text proofreading, with global shortcuts
Study tab: courses generated by a model on any subject
Interface in English, Spanish and French

description.p: ChatonLM is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Ollama. "Ollama" is a trademark of its owner and is used only to describe compatibility.
